brief.note: Lululemon cut guidance a third time; a federal housing regulator opened mortgage scoring to FICO's rival.

candidates.name: Edison International
candidates.business: California electric utility serving Los Angeles through Southern California Edison
candidates.cause: State lawmakers advanced a wildfire bill omitting the liability protections investors expected, leaving Edison exposed to insurer subrogation claims from fires its equipment starts.
candidates.right: Lawmakers must revisit liability relief before the autumn wildfire season tests the balance sheet
candidates.wrong: A major fire season lands with no liability cap and financing costs spiral

candidates.name: Fair Isaac Corporation
candidates.business: Owns the FICO credit score and sells analytics software to lenders
candidates.cause: The federal housing regulator told Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac to accept rival VantageScore credit scores, opening FICO's mortgage-scoring monopoly to competition.
candidates.right: Lenders must stick with FICO scores despite now being free to switch
candidates.wrong: VantageScore takes mortgage share and FICO loses pricing power on its best scores

candidates.name: lululemon athletica inc.
candidates.business: Athletic apparel brand selling leggings and activewear through its own stores
candidates.cause: Cut full-year guidance for the third time, now seeing sales fall 5% to 7% and EPS near $9.60, with China continuing to disappoint.
candidates.right: Product newness must revive North American demand before discounting erodes the brand
candidates.wrong: Competitors keep taking share and a fourth guidance cut follows this one

candidates.name: PG&E Corporation
candidates.business: California utility supplying gas and electricity across northern and central California
candidates.cause: The state wildfire bill dropped the liability fix utilities wanted; PG&E has since begun reviewing a possible reorganization and deferred $2bn of 2027 capital spending.
candidates.right: The legislature must deliver a liability backstop before the review forces harder options
candidates.wrong: The reorganization review becomes a restructuring and shareholders face the 2019 outcome again

candidates.name: MongoDB, Inc.
candidates.business: Developer database platform sold mainly through its Atlas cloud service
candidates.cause: Q2 revenue rose 30% and guidance was raised, but Atlas and AI growth missed elevated expectations and stock compensation swallowed most of non-GAAP profit.
candidates.right: Atlas growth must reaccelerate enough to justify a multiple near sixty times earnings
candidates.wrong: Growth keeps decelerating while stock-based pay keeps flattering the profits investors buy
